mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_popbill_config (corp_number, link_id, popbill_id, encrypted_key, sender_number, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{corpNumber}, #{linkId}, #{popbillId}, #{encryptedKey}, #{senderNumber}, #{center.centerCode}, SYSDATETIME());
